# District-wise  Population in Sri Lanka

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Figure 6: District-wise Population based on 2024 Census"
#| out-width: 100%
library(tidyverse)
population <- read_csv("population.csv")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

population_long <- population %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>% 
  mutate(
    District = factor(District, levels = District)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Male, Femal),
    names_to = "Gender",
    values_to = "Population"
  )

ggplot(population_long,
       aes(x = Population, 
           y = District, 
           fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "#1b9e77",   
      "Femal" = "#D55E00"   # orange
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "District Population (Highest to Lowest)",
    x = "Population",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
